'''Port Town''' was an area of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] that had an infamous reputation for being the home of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], criminals, and outlaws.

==Characteristics==
It covered levels 121 through 160 of the city and was filled with industrial-scale loading bays, as well as areas that were pretty cheap to rent due to their unattractive surroundings. Not unlike the undercities of [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant]] or [[Nar Shaddaa's Undercity|Nar Shaddaa]], Port Town is largely a seedy underworld with walls lined with blaster scorches and the floors that are covered with scrap metal and assorted garbage.<ref name="GG2nd" />

==History==
Port Town was the site of illegal trafficking and gambling rings, which were difficult to shut down permanently, due to the wide dispersion of gambling halls and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] throughout the industrial compounds.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] once leased some space there to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] so he could build a [[Han Solo's sky house|repulsorlift house]]. It was also home to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Boddu Bocck]], [[Beylyssa]], and [[Tolga]]. [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Birket]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] ventured into Port Town to hire the hunters.
